descriptions.d24l_label_text_802b1714: Refreshes a label's text: when the error string +80 is set and bit 0x40000000 of flags +188 at 0x804b1788 is on, shows that error. Otherwise copies the text name at +68 of the +12 context and, unless it is '<NO_CHANGE>', shows the looked-up text resource, an 'ERROR: No such Text Resource' message when the lookup fails, or an empty string when the name is empty.
